skill.name: php-pro
skill.description: Guides modern PHP development with generators, iterators, SPL data structures, PHP 8+ features, strict typing, and performance-focused design.
skill.summary: Build idiomatic, memory-efficient PHP applications with modern language features and measured performance choices.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The single static finding is a false positive caused by markdown backticks around a resource file path. I found no prompt injection, data exfiltration intent, or executable code in SKILL.md.

static_findings.snippet: - If detailed examples are required, open `resources/implementation-playbook.md`.

finding_verdicts.reason: Line 25 uses markdown backticks to format resources/implementation-playbook.md as a file path. It does not instruct command execution or include shell syntax.

content.value_statement: Advanced PHP work needs careful choices for memory, types, and architecture. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code toward idiomatic PHP 8+ solutions.
actual_capabilities: Designs generator and iterator patterns for memory-efficient processing.
Applies SPL data structures when they provide clear performance benefits.
Uses PHP 8+ features such as enums, attributes, match expressions, and constructor promotion.
Improves type safety with strict typing, unions, intersections, and custom exceptions.
Recommends profiling before optimization and favors built-in PHP functions.
Structures PHP code around namespaces, autoloading, PSR standards, and SOLID principles.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not automatic runtime profiling.
It does not replace project-specific security review or production testing.
It may need framework context before giving Laravel, Symfony, or custom architecture advice.
It prefers PHP standard library features and may avoid package recommendations unless necessary.

use_cases.title: Optimize Large Data Processing
use_cases.description: Refactor array-heavy logic into generator or iterator flows that reduce memory pressure.

use_cases.title: Modernize Legacy PHP Code
use_cases.description: Update older PHP services with strict types, PHP 8+ syntax, and clearer object boundaries.

use_cases.title: Design Production PHP Components
use_cases.description: Plan namespaces, exceptions, logging hooks, and PSR-compliant structure for reusable PHP modules.

prompt_templates.title: Review a PHP Function
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review for clarity and correctness
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this PHP function for type safety, error handling, and readable structure. Suggest concise improvements without changing its behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Use Generators for Memory
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this PHP data-processing flow to use generators or iterators where useful. Explain memory benefits and any tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Modernize PHP 8 Architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Modernize this PHP service with PHP 8+ features, strict typing, custom exceptions, and PSR-compatible organization.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Performance Optimization
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this PHP performance problem. Identify likely bottlenecks, propose profiling steps, and recommend safe optimizations using built-in features first.

output_examples.input: A PHP script loads a large CSV into an array before processing rows.
output_examples.output: The skill would propose a generator-based row reader, explain memory impact, and note error handling for malformed records.

output_examples.input: A legacy class uses weak typing, mixed returns, and unclear exception behavior.
output_examples.output: The skill would recommend strict types, explicit return types, domain exceptions, and clearer method boundaries.

output_examples.input: A team wants to speed up a PHP queue worker.
output_examples.output: The skill would start with profiling, inspect data structures, and suggest SPL queues or heaps only when metrics support them.

best_practices: Share PHP version, framework, and deployment context before asking for architecture guidance.
Ask for profiling plans before accepting performance changes.
Include edge cases, input sizes, and failure modes when requesting implementation help.
anti_patterns: Do not optimize PHP code before measuring the bottleneck.
Do not replace built-in PHP functions with custom implementations without a clear reason.
Do not request broad rewrites without specifying behavior that must stay unchanged.

faq.question: Does this skill run PHP code?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and examples for PHP development.

faq.question: Which PHP versions does it target?
faq.answer: It focuses on modern PHP 8+ features and patterns.

faq.question: Can it help with performance work?
faq.answer: Yes. It emphasizes profiling, generators, iterators, SPL structures, and measured optimization.

faq.question: Does it support PHP frameworks?
faq.answer: Yes, when framework context is provided. The core guidance remains language and architecture focused.

faq.question: Can it review security issues?
faq.answer: It can suggest validation and injection-prevention practices, but it does not replace a dedicated security audit.

faq.question: Is it useful for legacy code?
faq.answer: Yes. It can help modernize types, exceptions, structure, and readability while preserving behavior.
